headline: Monday on the Lake: Crisp air, clear water, and holiday cheer building
lede: Monday, November 16 — a perfect day to ease into Branson with cooler temps in the low 60s, light winds, and no rain in the forecast. Table Rock Lake levels stable, shows shifting into full holiday mode, and plenty of indoor options if the breeze picks up.

featured.title: Christmas In The Heartland
featured.why: Heartwarming holiday musical perfect for the whole family as the season kicks off

plan.title: Lake Morning
plan.detail: Catch sunrise over Table Rock Lake. Stable levels and clear water make for excellent early fishing or a peaceful walk along the shoreline.

plan.title: Holiday Show
plan.detail: Head to Americana Theatre for Christmas In The Heartland matinee. Warm vocals and festive spirit set the tone for the week.

plan.title: Evening Lights
plan.detail: Stroll the Landing for fountain shows and twinkling holiday lights. Grab dinner at a lakeside spot before an evening show.
